$Comment: New Year's Eve lifts XP in every skill for everyone on the server, on a server running MMO Skill Tree:
the hytale:mod_installed condition in Requires leaves the file out without it.
A standing boost: nobody starts it and it keeps no timer. It lifts every gain in the skills it names
while the rest of its Requires passes, and it counts as a server boost, so the cap in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/boost-settings.json bounds it like any other boost, the Christmas trades boost
Tracks.Categories names every skill category, so every skill gains and no reputation does. Percent is
how much more XP they earn: 25 is a quarter more. ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live reads 1 only while that
calendar event runs, so this boost needs both Christmas and its one-day event Christmas_New_Years_Eve
(December 31st) running. Text.TitleKey names it on the Boosts page; its words are in christmas.mmo.lang.
To change or switch it off, write this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/boosts.json
